features.faqQ1: If I update my profile, do I need to reprint cards or QR codes?
features.faqA1: No. All QR codes and NFC cards are dynamic. They point to your permanent ID — updates apply immediately without touching the physical asset.
features.faqQ2: Does the NFC chip need an app on the recipient's phone?
features.faqA2: No app needed. Recent iPhones and most Android phones read NFC natively and open your ProfileLink page in the system browser.
features.faqQ3: Can I import my history from LinkedIn?
features.faqA3: Yes — our assistant reads your public LinkedIn URL or archive export to rebuild timeline, recommendations, and badges in under two minutes.
features.faqQ4: Can I connect my own custom domain?
features.faqA4: Yes. Set a CNAME (e.g. contact.mycompany.com) with automatic Let's Encrypt SSL issuance and renewal.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to start with ProfileLink confidently.
faq.q1: How is ProfileLink different from Linktree or my LinkedIn profile?
faq.a1: LinkedIn is a closed social network that forces visitors to sign in, with ads and competing profiles. Linktree stacks superficial social links. ProfileLink is a premium structured portfolio with your work, QR code, verifiable certifications, and direct contact details — no friction.
faq.q2: What happens if I print my QR code and then change email or job?
faq.a2: Nothing bad! All our QR codes are dynamic. Change company, phone, links, or bio — the QR already printed on your cards still points to your latest information.
faq.q3: Does someone scanning my QR or NFC card need the ProfileLink app?
faq.a3: No. A camera or NFC-capable smartphone is enough. The profile opens in the browser — no download or account required for the visitor.
faq.q4: Is my personal data protected and hosted in Europe?
faq.a4: Yes. Our hosting is in the European Union. We never sell personal or behavioral data to ad networks. You can export everything and permanently delete your account in full GDPR compliance.
faq.q5: How does the metal NFC physical card work?
faq.a5: The ProfileLink Metal NFC Series card is programmed with your unique link. A tap on a modern smartphone opens your profile with no app. You can update profile content anytime without reprogramming the card.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How ProfileLink collects, uses, and protects your personal data.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.p1: ProfileLink Technologies Inc. is the controller for data collected via the site and app. Contact: privacy@profilelink.me.

s2.title: 2. Data we collect
s2.p1: We collect data you provide (account, profile, contact details) and technical data (logs, view/click/scan analytics) required to run the service.
s2.p2: We do not sell your data to ad networks. Analytics stay tied to your account.

s3.title: 3. Purposes
s3.p1: Service delivery, account security, product improvement, customer support, and legal obligations.

s4.title: 4. Retention & rights
s4.p1: Account data is kept while your account is active, then archived or deleted per our obligations.
s4.p2: You have rights of access, rectification, export, and deletion. Contact privacy@profilelink.me or use Settings tools.

s5.title: 5. Hosting
s5.p1: Application and database servers are hosted in the European Union, with encryption in transit (HTTPS).

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.subtitle: The rules that govern use of ProfileLink.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance
s1.p1: By creating an account or using ProfileLink, you accept these terms. If you act for an organization, you warrant you have authority to do so.

s2.title: 2. Account & content
s2.p1: You are responsible for keeping credentials confidential and for content published on your profiles (accuracy, legality, third-party rights).
s2.p2: We may suspend an account for abuse, unlawful content, or circumvention of plan limits.

s3.title: 3. Plans & payments
s3.p1: The Free plan is limited. Pro and Team are billed per the published pricing. Refunds follow the commercial policy in force.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual property
s4.p1: ProfileLink and its marks remain our property. You keep your content; you grant us a limited license to host and display it.

s5.title: 5. Limitation of liability
s5.p1: The service is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is capped at amounts paid in the last 12 months.

s1.title: Publisher
s1.p1: ProfileLink Technologies Inc. — company publishing the ProfileLink platform.

s2.title: Publication director
s2.p1: The publication director is the legal representative of ProfileLink Technologies Inc.

s3.title: Hosting
s3.p1: Application and database hosting: cloud infrastructure in the European Union. Technical details available on legitimate request.

s4.title: Intellectual property
s4.p1: All site elements (brand, design, copy, software) are protected. Unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.

cookies.title: Cookie settings
cookies.subtitle: Which cookies we use and how to control them.

s1.title: 1. What is a cookie?
s1.p1: A cookie is a small file stored on your device. It remembers preferences (language, session) and keeps the service working.

s2.title: 2. Essential cookies
s2.p2: NEXT_LOCALE — remembers FR/EN language (required for comfort).

s3.title: 3. Audience measurement
s3.p1: View, click, and scan counters are first-party metrics tied to your profile. We do not use third-party ad pixels.

s4.title: 4. Your choices
s4.p1: You can delete cookies in your browser settings. Signing out clears the session. Without essential cookies, some features (login, language) will not work.
